contract: BB38: the onboarding funnel (Config.Analytics.Steps, 13 steps in order with A23-68's first 3 minutes and A23-71 S13's FirstSkillHit after FirstWeapon, before AutoUnlocked; once per account, old saves catch up in that order), c->s UiMetric(id) -> WindowOpen_<id> (Config.Analytics.UiIds, one argument, ready, 2 s, once a session), KeyRebind (SettingsService.KeysChanged), AutoOn / AutoOff, FirstDeath_<By> (CombatService.KnockedOut, once per account), Plunder_Kept / _Avenged / _Returned, EnhanceFailLeave (a failed enhance then a leave within 300 s), SameKindStreak (30 in a row, once a session per kind), ReturnAct (a returning player's first 3 zone / window actions); at leave: SessionMinutes, AutoAwayMinutes (auto ON, no own action for 300 s), GoldIn / GoldOut per source / sink (ProgressionService.GoldEarned / GoldSpent with reasons), FriendMinutes, KillsTogether / KillsWithFriend (MonsterKilled Party / Others, IsFriendsWith once per pair), ZoneMinutes, RankingViews. No names, UserIds or free text; Studio prints every call ([Metrics]).
limitations: The real AnalyticsService dashboard and its limits are not reached offline. The client's UiMetric sends (Panels, the Tab list) are game dev 1's. The 5-minute loop (HighLevelInMeadow, ServerPopulation) is not stepped here (unchanged).
